race.comment: COOL BLAZE (4) got off the mark in style here two preps ago and was good in his first two starts last time in before pulling up with excuses on the Acton when last sighted. Has trialled nicely in readiness off a short break and can make a bright return. INCHYRA (6) also resumes and is a consistent mare, having won two of her past three starts with Boudvillain aboard. Worth noting she was a good winner to kick things off last time in. BALLYHOO (8) has been safely held at Wyong but drops into a more suitable race. SHE'S THE KEY (7) won narrowly by a nose last time out at Wagga but rises in weight. Expected to go close.
